examples.title: Calculate wording categories within a routed section
examples.use: Set hidden wording categories from multiple selected advice providers.
requirements: RECONTACT_GROUP, PF15b and both HID_PF21 outputs; enter at the selected condition.
limitations: Piping/rendering and ancestor eligibility are not executed.
observations: Priority is the highest matching category in this export, not a general coding rule.

examples.title: Ask a follow-up only for multiple answers
examples.use: Copy the sole selected code, or visit the follow-up question for multiple selections.
requirements: Declare A10 and writable A11, including explicit null.
limitations: Question requiredness and ancestor conditions require Forsta.
observations: An empty answer takes the autocode branch but leaves A11 missing.

examples.title: Reject conflicting multicode answers
examples.use: Check a specific subset conflict across all 128 subsets of seven codes.
limitations: XML Punch=Single and UI exclusivity are not automatically applied.

examples.title: Update session fields at a fixed time
examples.use: Check path, page count and indexed session duration writes.
requirements: Explicit currentForm, timestamp, attempt index and declared indexed cells.
limitations: One explicit global-hook invocation; navigation/retries and real hook order require Forsta.

examples.title: Map extended statuses to sample state
examples.use: Verify queue/contact/screener writes at status boundaries.
requirements: Distinct respondent and field stores; extendedStatus; EarlyCompFlg.
limitations: No CATI scheduler or persistent sample database.

examples.title: Characterise mocked email validation categories
examples.use: Test exact service requests and category-dependent validation using synthetic responses.
requirements: Original Generic functions defines errormessage; synthetic email; FIFO HTTP response; labels and language.
limitations: Provider semantics, outages/retries and real credentials are not tested.
observations: Suspicion: includes("accept_all","role_address","disposable") only tests accept_all in JavaScript. Current acceptance of the other two is not recommended policy.

examples.title: Standard-shell credit eligibility
examples.use: Assert attempted credits and dummy-sample exclusion.
requirements: See fixtures for exact helper-loading steps and record/reference values.
limitations: An attempted credit does not prove remote payment, idempotency or persistence.
observations: Standard eligibility differs from the omnibus example.

examples.title: Omnibus credit eligibility by sections
examples.use: Check credits when completed-section count affects eligibility.
requirements: Synthetic section count, dummy flag, status and exact helper steps.
limitations: No concurrent redemption or real service test.
observations: A positive section count can make an otherwise non-complete status eligible. Confirm intended policy.

examples.title: Protect completed outcomes on return
examples.use: Check the full previous/new completion-code table and terminal stops.
requirements: Explicit query scode (null means absent) and configured completion/screen codes.
limitations: Stop records intent, not a persisted Forsta status.

examples.title: Build a redirect using a sample URL
examples.use: Test source helper and SID propagation without navigating a browser.
requirements: Original GetBaseURL helper; synthetic ExternalSurveyLink, sid, writable client_url.
limitations: Existing case uses a URL with a query; URL encoding and unusual input need separate cases.

examples.title: Union earlier selections with fixed options
examples.use: Carry selected codes forward and always include 97 and 99.
requirements: BC_3x9 values. Referenced answer list 1652542516 remains a Forsta configuration dependency.
limitations: Mask code order is insertion order in this model; UI order and exclusivity are separate.

examples.title: Use a source helper for a context-dependent option set
examples.use: Test masking2x3 for device codes and smartphone boundary branches.
requirements: Load helper from original ScriptCode; seed BC_2x3_loop explicitly and conditional BC_2x1a/b inputs.
limitations: Cases simulate one loop context each. Loop traversal and implicit cell scoping are unsupported.

examples.title: Show a follow-up for a selected code
examples.use: Test a Boolean question mask for selected, unselected and missing answers.
limitations: Mask is evaluated explicitly; route visits do not apply it automatically.

examples.title: Remove a scale option using an explicit domain
requirements: currentForm=QD6 and explicit QD6_1 domain; XML references do not infer the fixture domain.
limitations: Row precode mask, UI order and browser hideDKREF_grid are inspectable but not executed by these cases.

examples.title: Reveal a DK column after prompting or an existing answer
examples.use: Test the Boolean DK column mask independently of rendering.
limitations: Numeric-cell validation, REF column and parent grid rendering remain outside these selected cases.

examples.title: Validate a numeric range using an earlier answer
examples.use: Check group-dependent lower bounds, upper bounds, malformed input and DK/refusal bypass.
limitations: XML numeric input rules and getDB2Text piping are not executed; only validation script.
observations: Missing DB2 with no no-response flag coerces to zero for comparisons. It passes group 4 but fails group 1. Confirm in Forsta before relying on this.

examples.title: Clear invalid grid cells and report the last error
examples.use: Characterise invalid codes 5/6 in rows a/f and their ordered clearing writes.
requirements: Explicit P_INTENTIONS[a]/[f], source errormessage helper, synthetic labels and language.
limitations: Browser code also hides these options; that rendering is not tested.
observations: When both rows are invalid both clear, but the second helper call replaces the first message. This is current behaviour, not a UX recommendation.

examples.title: Follow a call to its original callable block
examples.use: Resolve BlockToCallEntityId and execute an ordered timestamp block.
limitations: Randomised callable order, recursion, end-block lifecycle and platform date serialization need Forsta confirmation.

examples.title: Inspect a masked loop with conditional member wording
examples.use: Inspect members, children and conditional text; test the loop mask code set.
requirements: Explicit Hid_T1_NEW selections. Other loop body inputs are visible in extracted code.
limitations: Loop traversal, implicit indexed response binding and caret text substitution are unsupported. Never infer that the loop body passed from the mask result.
